name.ja: ハロプラ 黒い三連ハロ

description.ja: 内部機構まで再現しながらも簡単に組み立てられるハロプラから、黒い三連星仕様のハロが登場！
description.en: From Haropura, which reproduces the internal mechanism and is easy to assemble, a black triple-star Haro is now available!

description.ja: • 耳は開閉し、手足は差し替えで再現！
description.en: • The ears can be opened and closed, and the limbs can be recreated by replacing them!

description.ja: • 他のハロプラやプチッガイとの連結が可能！
description.en: • Can be connected with other Haropla and Petitgguy!

description.ja: • 余剰パーツは台座に収納できる。
description.en: • Excess parts can be stored on the pedestal.

description.ja: • ３機分のナンバーを再現できるホイルシールが付属。
description.en: • Comes with a foil seal that can reproduce the numbers of 3 aircraft.
